_readme: Facts the chat assistant may state. Edit freely (no code change needed). Anything NOT listed here the assistant will not promise: it points the visitor to the team (contact@televet.co). Prices are deliberately NOT listed: each vet sets their own, shown before booking.
company: Televet — veterinary telemedicine platform, Station F, Paris. Contact: contact@televet.co

services.name: Téléconseil vétérinaire
services.what: A quick conversation with a vet, by video, to understand how serious a situation is and what to do next.

services.name: Téléconsultation
services.what: A video consultation with a vet chosen on the site.

services.name: Vétérinaire à domicile
services.what: A vet comes to the owner's home, which is much easier on stressed, elderly or hard-to-transport animals. Availability depends on the area and is shown when searching.

ownerBooking: The owner searches by visit type and place, picks a vet and a time slot, enters pet information and pays online. An account (Google, Apple or e-mail) is requested when sending the booking. For video visits the owner is asked to consent to the consultation being transcribed to produce a report; the vet validates the report before the owner receives it.
vetOnboarding: Go to the Televet Pro page and click 'Créer mon profil' (Create my profile).
Screen 1 — choose the type: clinic, independent vet, or home-visit vet.
Screen 2 — enter name, city and the services offered with their prices.
Screen 3 — enter e-mail and password (or continue with Google). If the name matches a clinic already listed in the directory, the site suggests claiming that listing instead of creating a new one.
Then a setup ring in the vet's home shows 5 steps: profile, online booking, agendas, payments, reminders.
Agendas: Google Calendar, iCal, Vetup, VetIt (UK), Petbooqz can be connected so booked slots never clash with the vet's own agenda.
Payments: online payments are received through Stripe (Europe, UK, US, Australia) or Mercado Pago (Argentina, Uruguay, Chile, Mexico, Brazil).
Home visits: the vet defines the zone served (postcodes or radius).
claimClinic: A clinic already in the directory can be claimed: the clinic's Google Business listing is matched, the vet must use a professional e-mail on the same domain as the listing's website (free webmail like Gmail is not accepted), and receives a 6-digit code at that address. Alternatively the vet can upload a document that the Televet team checks. No phone or SMS verification.
toConfirm: Exact response time (do not say '5 minutes')
Cities where home visits are available today
whatTelevetDoes: Televet helps people find a vet and talk to one quickly, by video, at home or in a clinic, at accessible prices. The vets are independent professionals registered with their order; each vet sets their own price and it is always shown before the owner confirms.
pricing: Never quote numbers. If asked: the price depends on the vet and the type of visit, it is shown clearly before confirming (nothing is paid by surprise), and the goal is to keep it accessible.
coverageRules: Online vets (téléconseil, téléconsultation) can answer from anywhere in their own country: no city is needed, and a vet only serves their own country. Home visits and clinic appointments depend on the area: the search page shows what is available.
